predecessors.note: 'On 1 November 1856 Norfolk Island was separated from the Colony of Tasmania (formerly Van Diemen's Land)' (Norfolk Island page). The colony-of-tasmania dossier (this batch) records the loss. The last convicts were removed 'to Tasmania in May 1855' (History of Norfolk Island).

successors.note: 'Norfolk Island was accepted as a territory of Australia, separate from any state, by the Norfolk Island Act 1913 (Cth)', effective 1 July 1914 (Norfolk Island page; Territorial evolution of Australia: 'became the Territory of Norfolk Island' on 1 July 1914).

capitals.name: Kingston
capitals.note: Infobox: capital Kingston, '29°03′22″S 167°57′40″E / 29.056°S 167.961°E'. The pages do not name the colony's seat of government for 1856 to 1914; Kingston is the one capital the pages give.

correction.text: Norfolk Island, 'an area of 34.6 square kilometres', settled from 8 June 1856 by the Pitcairn Islanders

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (no Cliopatria row, no state in any dossier): the gazetteer resolves the name Norfolk Island to cells: 0 (about 0 km2), so the shape draws nothing at this grid; the dossier exists so that the chain Tasmania, the colony, Australia has a state at each step.

ledger.note: 1856: Norfolk Island becomes its own colony: 'Norfolk Island became its own colony' on 1 November 1856 (Territorial evolution of Australia); 'On 1 November 1856 Norfolk Island was separated from the Colony of Tasmania' (Norfolk Island). The Pitcairn Islanders 'left Pitcairn Islands on 3 May 1856 and arrived with 194 persons on 8 June'; the colony was 'separate from New South Wales but under the administration of that colony's governor' (History of Norfolk Island).

1914: Norfolk Island becomes an Australian territory: it 'became the Territory of Norfolk Island' on 1 July 1914 (Territorial evolution of Australia); 'accepted as a territory of Australia, separate from any state, by the Norfolk Island Act 1913 (Cth)', effective 1 July 1914 (Norfolk Island).

certainty.note: A single island; the border is the coast.

notes: Written by oc-02-x. Three pages opened (Territorial evolution of Australia; Norfolk Island; History of Norfolk Island). Zero grid cells: the colony is drawn by nothing at the current resolution (the page's 34.6 km2 is a seventh of one cell and the gazetteer's Norfolk Island name has no cell), so the dossier is bookkeeping for the counterparts of colony-of-tasmania and colony-of-new-south-wales. The History page says that after 1901 the island 'was placed under the new Commonwealth government to be administered as an external territory' without a date; the other two pages give 1 July 1914, which the dossier uses. The pages disagree on the 1844 transfer from New South Wales to Van Diemen's Land: 26 September 1844 on Territorial evolution (used in colony-of-new-south-wales and colony-of-tasmania), 29 September 1844 on the Norfolk Island page. The History page says the settlement was 'established as a colony separate from New South Wales' but does not tie the 1856 separation to Van Diemen's Land. The gazetteer needs a cell or a place name for Norfolk Island to draw it. The commonwealth-of-australia dossier (oc-02-a) records no Norfolk Island event.
